children: Overview
New Zealand glass processor's unaudited H1 revenue rose 6% yr/yr to NZ$114.5 mln
Profit for the period fell 63% to NZ$1.1 mln from NZ$2.9 mln
On Nov. 16, Metro received a takeover notice from Amari Metals Australia
Outlook
Metro Performance Glass expects subdued New Zealand and Australian market conditions to continue in the short to medium term
Amari Metals Australia intends to make a full takeover offer for Metro Performance Glass
Forecasts compliance with conditions of its renegotiated banking facility
Result Drivers
MARKET SOFTNESS AND PRICE PRESSURE – Co said geopolitical uncertainty, subdued markets and competitive selling-price pressure continued to affect trading
YEAR-AGO DEBT EXTINGUISHMENT – H1 profit fell to NZ$1.07 mln from NZ$2.87 mln, against NZ$8.58 mln of year-ago significant items, chiefly a NZ$9.22 mln debt-extinguishment gain
NEW ZEALAND TURNAROUND – Co cited efficiency, productivity and service delivery; average daily insulated-glass-unit volumes rose 5%, while NZ revenue increased 7%
